thriving: Day {streak}. Nobody told me to stop, so I didn't.
{streak} days. Requested a medal. Denied. Continuing.
Streak status: classified. Fine. It's {streak}.
{streak} straight days on the grid. Command is nervous.
Hostiles spotted: zero. Commits spotted: {streak} days running.
I don't take days off. Neither does the operator. {streak} and counting.
Day {streak}. The contribution graph is just a wall of green now.
Reminder: {streak} days ago this was optional. Now it's doctrine.
Ammo full. Morale full. Streak: {streak}. Send recruiters.
{streak} days without missing. Even the cron job is impressed.
Overwatch report: operator shipped again. {streak} for {streak}.
Somebody bet against the streak on day 3. Day {streak}. Pay up.
{streak} days. At this point the streak keeps me alive, not food.
Mission log, day {streak}: pushed code, held the line, had snacks.
Still airborne. Still green. Still {streak}.
Bold of you to visit on day {streak} and not hire anyone.
{streak} days in. My battery runs on git push now.
Weekend? Never heard of it. Day {streak}.
Target acquired: tomorrow. Streak: {streak}. Engaging.
I ran the numbers. {streak} days. The numbers ran away.
Every green square is a confirmed kill. {streak} confirmed.
They said it couldn't be done. They said it {streak} times. Wrong every time.
Daily briefing: commit, survive, repeat. Day {streak} complete.
The streak is {streak}. My standards are higher than your coffee intake.
Holding position. Holding streak. {streak} days, zero retreats.
Radio check: still committing. {streak} days. Over.
If consistency had a rank, this would be general. Day {streak}.
Achievement unlocked: {streak}-day killstreak. Calling in a deploy.
{streak} days. I'm not a pet anymore. I'm a witness.
Day {streak}. Still haven't seen this operator log off.
hungry: One day dark. The streak is on life support, operator.
Comms silent for 24h. I'm not worried. I'm logging it.
Ammo low. Excuses high. Push something.
Missed a day. The enemy is called 'tomorrow'.
Radio check. Radio check. Is anyone pushing code out there?
Hovering on reserve power. A commit would help. A lot.
feral: THREE DAYS DARK. I am now targeting the README.
Signal lost. Morale lost. Streak lost. Send help or a commit.
Red alert. The contribution graph has gone grey.
I've started reading your commit history out loud. It's short.
Tell your recruiter I said hi. I'll be the one with the red light.
Mayday. Mayday. The operator has gone AWOL.
deceased: SIERRA is offline. Redeploy with a commit that says: i'm sorry.
Grounded. Lens dark. No excuses left.
Killed in action by an empty commit log.
The black box recorded everything. It's mostly silence.
revived: Redeployed. The apology is on the permanent record.
Respawned. Slightly angrier. Considerably more armed.
Second deployment authorised. There is a counter now.
I remember going down. I remember whose fault it was.
